description: Save a standing rule the user states about their posts or images, one rule at a time, without rewriting the rest of their style guide. 'always' rules feed what every post must include or follow; 'never' rules feed what must never appear in an image or a caption. Use it the moment the user says things like 'never show measuring tools', 'the stakes must always be red' or 'stop using maps'. get_brand_identity shows what is currently saved.

addAlways.description: Rules every post and image must follow

addNever.description: Things that must never appear in an image or caption

removeAlways.description: Wording of always-rules to drop (case-insensitive partial match)

removeNever.description: Wording of never-rules to drop (case-insensitive partial match)

name: update_content_rules
title: Update Content Rules
